gameDescriptionHtml:
Tales from the Dancing Moon is a casual life-sim RPG inspired by UK culture and fantasy novels.

After the events of a shadow-beast invasion on the seaside town of Ïllisor, you have the freedom of completing various villager quests, live life with sandbox gameplay, and finding collectable diaries to understand your role in this mysterious character-driven story.

Seasons of Illisor – From The Dancing Moon Inn to the Stoknel Swamp regions. Explore both hand-crafted and procedural zones with seasonal and weather effects, providing different moods to the game as time progresses.
Unravel the Mystery – Discover your role in this story as you complete a variety of quests and collect hidden diaries. Unravel the mystery of the missing teenagers who arrived before you and their entanglement between the tea-brewing Magisters and the deadly shadow-beasts.
Meet the Villagers – Fergus, Astryn, Quinn, Nicolas, Lyka, Lucas, Graham, Galeia
…and more – Learn more about Ïllisor and its villagers by pursuing various activities like side-quests, farming, crafting and fishing. Help rebuild the town from the recent invasion and get them back on their feet!

Will you discover your purpose and find a way back home? Track down those pesky teenagers? Or will you simply enjoy your time staying at The Dancing Moon?

Game Features

  • A character driven story inspired by young-adult and portal-fantasy stories. Told via quests and reading diaries scattered across the world.
  • A hybrid of RPG and life-sim with open-ended sandbox features.
  • Questing, farming, crafting, building, fishing, cooking, combat – just to name a few things you can do!
  • Season and weather effects.
  • Free object placement and village building systems.
  • Both hand crafted and procedural areas.
  • Photo mode with many lens and filter options.
